searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Phrases to score as given, one per line.

maxVideos.title: Videos per query
maxVideos.description: How many regular videos to save per query, in YouTube's order.

fetchChannels.title: Fetch channel subscriber counts
fetchChannels.description: Look up subscriber counts for each topic's top 5 channels.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.description: Interface language sent to YouTube, such as en.

region.title: Region (gl)
region.description: Country to search as, such as US, AE, IN, BR or GB.

seeds.title: Seed words
seeds.description: Expanded through YouTube search suggestions into the phrases people type now, e.g. nails, blush, hair porosity.

modifiers.title: Suggestion modifiers
modifiers.description: Words added after each seed before asking for suggestions.

alphabet.title: Expand seed + a-z
alphabet.description: Also ask for suggestions for each seed followed by every letter (26 more requests per seed).

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Countries to search as, e.g. US, AE, IN, BR, GB. Each region is a full pass.

maxTopics.title: Max phrases per region
maxTopics.description: Cap on phrases scored per region, best autocomplete rank first.

recentDays.title: Recent window (days)
recentDays.description: Videos newer than this count toward current demand.

smallChannelSubs.title: Small channel (subscribers)
smallChannelSubs.description: Channels under this count as small.

oldDays.title: Old video (days)
oldDays.description: Top results older than this count as old.

saveVideos.title: Save video rows
saveVideos.description: Also save the videos behind each topic.
